fieldValues.title: Setting up a domain costs the owner up to fourteen acts; the walks #89 and #90 are 23 days old with only the owner step open
fieldValues.summary: Agent steps of the end-to-end walks closed in 0 to 5 days; the owner-affirmation step is still open on both. Affirmation is 1:1 for problems and remedies and stalls at the axis layer (poles 18 of 94, tensions 26 of 47, principles 13 of 28). Sessions run at rubber-stamp speed. fieldValues.body: The decided moves (confidence grades care, 9d50126b; affirm the story not each record) are not yet what the tools ask for: the control room and the walks still put records up one at a time. The question is which of the fourteen acts carry judgement and which are bookkeeping that a chartered group or a rule can do.
